label: OpenCode stand: принять native export и V1 CI-сценарии
description: Расширить только tests/native/ahap_opencode_stand.py и его regression tests под V1 owner contract: export format=native с lossless bytes_base64, complete/source; common явно unsupported; discover(action=projects,instance_ref); второй отдельный deliver в ту же сессию, оба input/reply, search marker coverage, restart без resend. Live case только на опубликованном новом candidate с новым disposable scope; исторические receipts не переигрывать. Зафиксировать обязательные поля отчёта для CI REPORT.
acceptance: Source regression покрывает native lossless export, explicit common unsupported, projects discovery, два same-session deliver и search/reopen/no-resend checks. Новый manifest preflight проверяет hashes, launcher/mounts и exact runner/server protocol. Live receipt на новом candidate содержит по каждому сценарию status PASS/FAIL/UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN, stage=candidate|installed, source_commit, manifest_sha256, core/runner/opencode/node/bootstrap hashes+versions, run_id, instance_ref, session_ref, оба Task/request/native user+assistant IDs, search marker+coverage, export format/complete/source/decoded SHA256+length, restart/replay proof, model request delta и evidence/cleanup paths. QOCV1CI не PASS до candidate consumer receipt; старые операции не replay.
note: CONFIRMED API contract received directly in delegated assignment. CONFIG313d8c64 is only a historical launcher/config for artifact 1d89d04d; do not execute old send scenario. Await new V1 candidate manifest; no public send until immutable candidate and fresh scope exist.
